view.title: Callbacks
view.description: Call-backs promised to callers — dialed by your agents or handled by your team.

open.title: No open callbacks
open.description: Call-backs your agents promise to callers — and ones you schedule yourself — will show up here.

dueToday.title: Nothing due today
dueToday.description: Open callbacks scheduled for today will appear here.

history.title: No callback history yet
history.description: Completed, missed and canceled callbacks land here.

noMatch.title: No callbacks match
noMatch.description: Try a different search or clear some filters.

filters.searchAriaLabel: Search callbacks by topic or phone number

detail.emptyDescription: Select a callback to see its details.
detail.notFoundMessage: This callback doesn't exist or was removed.

createDialog.title: New callback
createDialog.description: Schedule a call back to a contact — handled by a team member or dialed by an AI agent.
createDialog.dncWarning: This contact is on your do-not-call list. The callback can still be scheduled, but consider whether they should be contacted.
createDialog.noAssignees: No team members with an account yet — invite one under <link>Team</link>.
createDialog.noAgents: No synced outbound agents — create one under <link>Agents</link> first.
createDialog.noNumbers: No dialable numbers — SIP numbers are inbound-only, so buy a platform number under <link>Phone numbers</link>.
createDialog.notesPlaceholder: Context for whoever makes the call (optional)

editDialog.title: Edit callback
editDialog.description: Update the topic, notes or who handles the callback.

rescheduleDialog.title: Reschedule callback
rescheduleDialog.description: Pick a new time. Call attempts restart, and the assignee's reminder will be sent again for the new time.

completeDialog.title: Complete callback
completeDialog.descriptionNamed: Record how the call back to {name} went.
completeDialog.descriptionUnnamed: Record how the call back to the contact went.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this callback?
cancelDialog.description: {name} won't be called back at {date}. This can't be undone.
